in_hebrew.long_meaning: El or God is my strength, wolf

in_greek.name: Ὀλάβιος
in_greek.long_meaning: From ὄλος (wolf) and ἀβας (father), Ὀλάβιος (Oláviós) means ‘wolf father’.

in_latin.name: Olavus
in_latin.long_meaning: Latin equivalent of the Old Norse name Óláfr (Olaf), meaning ‘wolf rider’ or ‘wolf descendant’.
